leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a parent component that passes content to a child component using the children prop
Construct a child component that receives and renders content through the children prop
Apply the children prop to display dynamic content within a reusable component
Configure a component to accept and project multiple content elements
Manipulate the children prop to conditionally render content based on component logic
Integrate the children prop with other component properties for flexible content display
Initialize a component structure that uses the children prop for content composition
